basic_profile.bio: Avid worldbuilder and sci-fi enthusiast living in Austin, Texas. Enjoys exploring the intersections of politics, technology, and speculative fiction. Typically active during evenings and weekends. Works as a software engineer with a passion for storytelling and narrative design. Single and enjoys spending time with a close circle of friends who share similar interests in gaming and literature.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a degree in Computer Science with a minor in Creative Writing. Extensive experience in software development and a lifelong passion for speculative fiction has led to a deep understanding of narrative structures and worldbuilding techniques. Regularly reads academic papers and online discussions on technology and societal trends.
